mainImage.alt: Aerial photograph of a massive industrial warehouse building consumed by bright orange flames, with thick black smoke billowing into the night sky
mainImage.caption: An aerial view shows the massive Kimberly-Clark warehouse in Ontario, California fully engulfed in flames on April 7, 2026. The 1.2 million square foot distribution center was destroyed in a six-alarm fire that required 175 firefighters from across Southern California to contain. The incident sparked a national conversation about labor exploitation, wage stagnation, and the breaking point of workers under economic pressure.
